title: 第一卷 第3章 太玄考核第一卷 第4章 不正经的七宝葫芦
slug: 师叔你的法宝太不正经了

回山门路上的李寒舟莫名的感觉到一股冷意。
总觉得好像是有谁在背后算计他一样。
“不会是那么算命的大婶在念叨我吧。”想到那个大婶临走时候依依不舍想要吃了自己的表情，李寒舟就一身冷颤。
这边听叶紫樱说完，叶云也是失望至极。
本以为这次他终于能帮上家里，能帮上父亲了，谁知道最后竟然还是被人骗了，于是随手就将符篆给放到桌子上，失望的离开了。
“这么大的人了，还能被路边的骗子轻易的就给骗了，我怎么生了你这么个没用的儿子，你看看你姐，你姐像你这么大的时候都已经是上清宗的弟子了，你……”叶青北气不打一处来的对着叶云的背影唉声叹气的说着。
叶云麻木的走出去，这些话他都已经听的耳朵快出茧子了。
自己就是不如姐姐，这有什么办法？
叶紫樱没有说什么，似乎对自己这个弟弟也是失望透顶。
“爹，你放心好了。”叶紫樱此刻淡淡的说道：“家中的确是有淡淡的妖气，我没有找到这只妖怪到底在哪，不过只要它再出现，我必定让它试试我上清宗的武学。”
“好，有你在，为父就放心了。”叶青北满意的点点头。
等李寒舟回到长生观的时候，已经是傍晚了。
“我回来了。”
李寒舟喊着。
石命和云千竹听到李寒舟的声音，都不太情愿的从自己的屋子里出来。
因为李寒舟以前每次回来，都是赌输了钱，还会喝很多酒，喝的伶仃大醉，回来心情不好拿他们撒气，石命上次顶嘴过一次，还被李寒舟狠狠打过一巴掌。
所以他们听到李寒舟回来的声音，都会浑身发怵。
“都看什么呢，过来搭把手。”
看到两人躲在石墩子后面看着自己，李寒舟笑着说。

两人讪讪的走近过来，才发现李寒舟似乎并没有喝酒。
“这是什么！”两人看到李寒舟手里拿着的肉还有米，简直不敢相信自己的眼睛，从他们记事起，都是李寒舟拿宗门的东西出去卖，什么时候往回拿过东西？
这今天是赌赢了吗？
“米和肉，去，拿厨房去。”
李寒舟吩咐着。
“是！”
两人扛起肉和米就去厨房了。
别看他们年纪小，但是也有二品修为了，论力气比普通人要强的多的多，这点东西轻轻松松就搬了过去。
“我晚上给你们露一手。”李寒舟宰了肥羊，心情很好，决定亲自下厨，这几天的素菜真的是吃腻了。
说着，李寒舟就将买来的糖葫芦递给了石命和云千竹。
“一人一串，别打架啊。”说完，李寒舟就进厨房准备去做饭了。
石命和云千竹愣愣的站在原地，看着手里的糖葫芦，两人的脸上露出了惊恐的表情。
“三师兄……师叔怕是在外面欠债还不上，打算把可爱的我给卖了吧？”云千竹此刻双腿都在打哆嗦。
石命更是狠狠咽了一口口水：“又买吃的回来，又做饭，还有钱给我们买糖葫芦，怕是连我也要卖啊，估计已经商量好价格了，人家付了定金了吧……”
“师妹，我们不能坐以待毙，师兄们都不在，我们两个要自救才行！”石命坚定的对云千竹说着。

Li Hanzhou felt an inexplicable chill on the way back to Shanmen.
He always felt as if someone was plotting against him behind his back.
"It can't be that fortune-telling aunt talking about me." Li Hanzhou shivered when he thought of the aunt's expression of being reluctant to leave and wanting to eat him before she left.
After listening to Ye Ziying's words, Ye Yun was also extremely disappointed.
I thought that this time he could finally help his family and his father, but who knew that he was deceived in the end, so he casually put the talisman on the table and left disappointed.
"You are such an old man, and you can be easily deceived by liars on the roadside. Why did I give birth to such a useless son like you? Look at your sister. Your sister was already a disciple of the Shangqing Sect when she was your age. You..." Ye Qingbei said angrily to Ye Yun's back, sighing.
Ye Yun walked out numbly. His ears were almost numb from hearing these words.
I am just not as good as my sister, what can I do?
Ye Ziying didn't say anything, and seemed to be extremely disappointed with her younger brother.
"Dad, don't worry." Ye Ziying said calmly at this moment: "There is indeed a touch of evil spirit in the house. I have not found where this monster is, but as long as it appears again, I will definitely let it try the martial arts of my Shangqing Sect."
"Okay, as long as you are here, I will feel relieved as a father." Ye Qingbei nodded with satisfaction.
By the time Li Hanzhou returned to Changsheng Temple, it was already evening.
"I'm back."
Li Hanzhou shouted.
Shi Ming and Yun Qianzhu came out of their rooms reluctantly when they heard Li Hanzhou's voice.
Because every time Li Hanzhou came back before, he lost money in gambling, drank a lot of wine, and got very drunk. When he came back, he was in a bad mood and took it out on them. Shi Ming talked back once and was slapped hard by Li Hanzhou.
So when they heard Li Hanzhou's return, they would feel frightened.
"What are you looking at? Come here and help me."
Seeing the two of them hiding behind Shi Dunzi and looking at him, Li Hanzhou said with a smile.
The two of them approached in a nonchalant manner, only to realize that Li Hanzhou didn't seem to be drinking.
"What is this!" The two of them couldn't believe their eyes when they saw the meat and rice in Li Hanzhou's hand. As long as they could remember, Li Hanzhou had been taking things from the sect out to sell. When did he take things back?
Did you win your bet today?
"Rice and meat, go and take them to the kitchen."
Li Hanzhou ordered.
"Yes!"
The two of them carried the meat and rice and went to the kitchen.
Despite their young age, they still have second-grade cultivation and are much stronger than ordinary people. This thing can be easily moved over.
"I'll show you my skills tonight." Li Hanzhou was in a good mood after slaughtering the fat sheep and decided to cook it himself. He was really tired of eating vegetarian dishes these days.
With that said, Li Hanzhou handed the candied haws he bought to Shi Ming and Yun Qianzhu.
"One person at a time, don't fight." After saying that, Li Hanzhou went into the kitchen to prepare for cooking.
Shi Ming and Yun Qianzhu stood there blankly, looking at the candied haws in their hands with horrified expressions on their faces.
"Third senior brother... I'm afraid that senior uncle is planning to sell me, my lovely daughter, because he has to pay off his debts outside, right?" Yun Qianzhu's legs were trembling at the moment.
Shi Ming swallowed hard: "I bought food again, cooked again, and I still have money to buy us candied haws. I'm afraid even I have to sell it. I guess the price has been negotiated, and I think I paid the deposit..."
"Junior sister, we can't sit still and wait for death. The senior brothers are not here. The two of us have to save ourselves!" Shi Ming said firmly to Yun Qianzhu.
